entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello, David. I'm calling about an order I received. I'm just so disappointed... I think I need to return this jersey I bought.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely help you with a return. Do you have the order number available?
Yes, it's VF8675309. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I was really looking forward to this piece, but it just didn't work out.
I see the order right here. Thank you. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, it's the fit. It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just so incredibly tight, I can barely breathe in it. I thought about an exchange, but... honestly, I really needed this money back for some unexpected bills. I feel awful about it.
I completely understand, and please don't feel bad. Let me just pull up our return policy to confirm the details for you. One moment.

Okay, I've got it. I see here that the delivery was 26 days ago, and for an item like a jersey, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within that window, so I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you.

Of course. It's our pleasure to help. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, place the item back in its packaging, and drop it at the post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse processes it.
That sounds easy enough. You've been very helpful, David. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
